I've replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. The store is **Pine Crossing**.

- **Source:** her own post in #central-team on 9 June 2026. She wrote that the Pine Crossing morning receiver said the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift. A driver had arrived at 7:10, and staff wrote his trailer number on a sticky note.
- **Follow-up:** Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem with the store login. I couldn't find any later update in the channel or the shared files.
- **Not found:** I didn't see a city or site code for Pine Crossing in anything Pree can see. I told her to get those from store ops or the rollout tracker.
